en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a long brick military barracks complex lining a tree‑planted street. Several multi‑storey buildings with arched windows and decorative brickwork stretch into the distance behind an iron fence and entrance gate. Small groups of people walk along the unpaved street. At the top left is red printed German text identifying the location as barracks in Chemnitz for the 3rd Royal Saxon Uhlan Regiment No. 21, named after Kaiser Wilhelm, King of Prussia.
